source.title: The Great Feast
source.description:
Your assistance has been invaluable. The citizens and soldiers of New Avalon can count on a hot meal tonight, and for many nights that follow. You have my gratitude, truly.

However, as you apparently read yourself, I have one last task to tend to before I can finally put my feet up. I can handle most of this myself, but if you're willing to do me one more favor, I will teach you my most famous recipes.

You will be eating like a Highlord every night.
source.objective: Aid Carrie Hearthfire in New Avalon one last time by gathering the following ingredients:
source.progress: Ah, it is wonderful to see you again. Have you brought me the last batch of ingredients I need?
source.completion:
Fast and reliable as always, I can't believe I ever doubted you. Allow me to take these off your hands.

Your motivations are still unclear to me but, it is apparent that you have a kind heart. As promised, here is my cookbook. I don't need it anymore, I have long since memorized all of my recipes.

Thank you again, and don't be a stranger.

<Carrie offers a sincere, relaxed smile before resuming her work.>
